scenarios.name: Home page loads
scenarios.reason: The confirmed home URL remains entirely empty after navigation and repeated waits; no main heading is available.
scenarios.diagnosis: The page crashes while starting because it tries to read part of something that is missing. As a result, none of the home page content is displayed.
scenarios.suggestion: Fix the home page startup code to handle the missing value before reading from it, then verify that the heading renders after a fresh visit to the home page.
